title: confiture migrate schema-to-schema analyze --format json
description: The source's tables in one schema (--schema, default public), sized and each given a recommended strategy (SchemaToSchemaMigrator.analyze_tables). The CLI assembles the envelope around it. A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead of this shape.

tables.description: Each table of the source's schema, by name; empty when the schema holds none.

row_count.description: The table's live-tuple estimate from pg_stat_user_tables, or an exact COUNT(*) when the estimate is zero or missing.

estimated_seconds.description: row_count over the strategy's nominal throughput, rounded to 3 decimals; at least 0.001 for a non-empty table, 0 for an empty one.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
